newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 28.988 million bushels wheat, 20.959 million bushels of corn and 202,000 bushels of barley inspected in the week to Sept 12 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
WHEAT: St. Lawrence S'way to Dominican Rep. 174; Togo 317.
Lakes to Algeria 663; Belgium 913; Morocco 676; South Africa 1,934; Venezuela 990.
Gulf to Brazil 965; Ecuador 323; Egypt 3,858; El Salvador 501; Guatemala 170; Honduras 497; Lebanon 808; Mexico 2,306; Nigeria 1,629; Peru 1,362; Venezuela 226.
WHEAT (cont.): Pacific to Taiwan 259; Japan 3,028; South Korea 897; Pakistan 2,825; Thailand 1,314; Yemen 1,213.
CORN: St Lawrence S'way to Dominican Republic 597.
Gulf to Taiwan 951; Colombia 868; Egypt 3,563; El Salvador 258; Guatemala 199; Japan 10,812; Mexico 1,248; Nicaragua 101; Panama 236; Tunisia 1,083.
